verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a workflow automation platform, but the evidence pack never documents batch or bulk actions, loops over item lists, or multi-item processing. The material on flows (trigger plus actions), agents and the MCP server's ability to 'manage tables' does not show acting on many items at once, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
